name: xTool M1 Ultra
notes: Multi-tool machine: blue diode laser heads plus inkjet printer, blade cutter and pen heads.
source: Image modes: xTool Studio's image mode list, values read from projects saved by xTool Studio for the M2 (2026-11-27); assumed the same for this machine. xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension ZH009 (exts/M1Ultra), read 2026-11-26. Work area from processingArea (300 x 300); laser heads from the head table (Active_Laser_Blue_Power_5/10/20) and the laser options laser_10W / laser_20W (the 5 W head has no laser string in the extension). Which operations each module can do is an assumption.
